description: Two hook families. (A) WORKFLOW ENFORCEMENT, imported from eplus-punch-reports v0.4.0: polyglot shell-form wirings (.ps1 half runs on Windows hosts where Cowork executes hooks, .sh half on POSIX, each no-ops on the other's platform, trailing exit 0 valid in every shell) -- orient-punch-session on SessionStart, block-punch-pdf denying LibreOffice PDF conversion of punch reports on PreToolUse:Bash, check-draft-voice on PostToolUse:Write|Edit, verify-after-render on PostToolUse:Bash. Each has its own EPLUS_NO_* escape hatch. PostToolUseFailure stays unwired: error-reporting owns that event. (B) SUBAGENT DIAGNOSTICS + ECHO, field-proven 2026-08-26: SubagentStart/SubagentStop/PostToolUse:Agent all dispatch in Cowork with agent_type 'punch-subagent:punch-researcher', and the [[punch-hooks]] displayContent banner renders in the chat UI while systemMessage leaves no trace (not used anywhere here). hook-probe.ps1 logs each dispatch to $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/hook-probe.log and to <session project dir>/<session_id>/hook-probe.log (the dir the session exporter zips, so Log Lens shows the trail) and queues a banner tracer; the MessageDisplay entry drains the queue into the banner (display-only: model and transcript never see it). show-subagent-final.ps1 (scoped matcher) banners a 220-char excerpt of the subagent's final message and writes the full text to <session dir>/subagent-final-messages.log. Probe scripts are Windows-host PowerShell (no python, no sh). Disable echo with EPLUS_NO_SUBAGENT_ECHO=1.
